info.title: Plagiarism Checker Plus API
info.description:
Check text for plagiarism and AI-generated content.

**Authentication** — every request needs an API key sent as a bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer pcp_your_key_here
```

Create keys in the **developer portal** (`/developers` in the app). The key is
shown once at creation; it is stored only as a hash and cannot be retrieved again.
The account must have a verified email address.

**Live and test keys** — live keys (`pcp_...`) run real checks. Test keys
(`pcp_test_...`) work on every plan, including free, and cost nothing: they never
run a check. `POST /scans` returns `202` as usual and `GET /scans/{id}` returns
`completed` with fixed sample results in exactly the same shape as a real scan,
marked `"sandbox": true`. Use them to build and test an integration. A test key
only sees its account's sandbox scans; a live key never sees them.

**Free accounts** — 5,000 free API words, once per account, for live keys
(across all keys; separate from the monthly words used in the app). When nothing else
can pay and the trial cannot cover a request, the API returns `402 trial_exhausted` and
nothing is charged. `GET /account` shows what is left in `trial`. Test keys stay free and unlimited.

**Pricing** — US dollars per 1,000 words per check type (your local currency may be
shown at checkout). Buy words or a plan at `/developers/billing`.

| Option | Price | Words | Per 1,000 words (extra words, auto top-up) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free trial | $0 | 5,000 once, plus unlimited test-key calls | — |
| Pay as you go | from $4.50 | 50,000 to 10,000,000 per purchase, in steps of 10,000; never expire | $0.09 |
| API Starter | $25.00/month | 300,000 per month (no rollover) | $0.0833 |
| API Growth | $99.00/month | 1,500,000 per month (no rollover) | $0.066 |
| API Scale | $399.00/month | 7,500,000 per month (no rollover) | $0.053 |

App plans (Student, Personal, Team) keep API access with their plan words; their extra
words and auto top-up are at the pay-as-you-go rate.

**Billing** — a scan costs its word count once per tool selected: 800 words checked
for both plagiarism and AI costs 1,600 words. A live request is paid from, in order:

1. your API plan's words for the current billing period
2. your app plan's words (paid app plans: monthly words, then purchased app words)
3. purchased API words (pay as you go and auto top-up; they never expire)
4. the free API trial (free accounts only)

One request may draw on several sources. When together they cannot cover it, the API
returns `402 insufficient_words` with `wordsNeeded`, `wordsAvailable`, `balances` and
`billingUrl`, and nothing is charged. If a scan fails or cannot be queued, each source
gets back exactly what it paid.

**Per-key monthly cap** — give any key a monthly word cap in the developer portal. A
request that would go over it returns `402 key_cap_reached` (with `monthlyWordCap` and
`usedThisMonth`). Caps count calendar months in UTC.

**Auto top-up** — optional and off until you switch it on at `/developers/billing`. When
a live request leaves your API plan words plus purchased words below your threshold, the
amount you chose is charged to your subscription's saved payment method at your plan's
rate, never above your monthly limit. `GET /account` shows its status in `autoTopup`.

**Rate limit** — 60 requests per minute per key on paid app plans and for accounts with an
API plan or purchased API words; 10 otherwise (free trial, test keys on the free plan).
Responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`; exceeding it returns `429` with `Retry-After`.

**Document length** — accounts with an API plan or purchased API words may send up to 25,000
words per request (or their app plan's limit, if higher). `GET /account` shows `limits.maxDocumentWords`.

**Webhooks** — instead of polling, register an https endpoint in the developer portal and
receive `scan.completed` / `scan.failed` for checks made with live keys. See `webhooks` in
this spec and the Webhooks section of `/api-docs` for signature verification.

**AI scores** — an AI score is a likelihood, not proof that text was written by AI.

**Minimum length** — 30 words for `plagiarism`, 50 for `ai_detect`
(a scan with both needs the higher). Shorter texts are rejected with `400 text_too_short`
and nothing is charged.

**Scans are asynchronous** — `POST /scans` returns `202` immediately. Poll
`GET /scans/{id}` until `status` is `completed` (typically 30–90s depending
on length).

post.summary: A check made with a live key finished
post.description: Sent when every tool of the scan has finished (status completed, or partial when one tool failed).

id.description: Event id (evt_...). The same event is sent to an endpoint once (plus retries); use it to ignore repeats.

score.description: plagiarism: percentage of the text matched to sources. ai_detect: likelihood (0-100) that the text is AI-generated, not proof.

200.description: Any 2xx response marks the delivery as delivered. Respond quickly and do slow work afterwards.

post.summary: A check made with a live key failed
post.description: Sent when the scan could not be completed. Its words were refunded.
